name: RBC Visa CreditLine for Small Business

localized_names.en: RBC Visa CreditLine for Small Business

apr.notes: Variable purchase rate from Prime + 2.9% to 11.9%, set at approval.

credit_required.notes: Canadian business owner who has reached the age of majority in their province or territory.

base_rate.description: 1 Avion point per $2 in net purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Avion points redeem for travel, gift cards, merchandise, statement credits and transfers to partner programs.

notes: The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none.
